SmartEase Matrix Sans — modified bitmap font family, 2026-10-30

Derived solely from GNU Unifont 16.0.04 font/precompiled/unifont-16.0.04.hex.
Copyright (C) 1998-2025 Roman Czyborra, Paul Hardy, Qianqian Fang,
Andrew Miller, Johnnie Weaver, David Corbett, Nils Moskopp,
Rebecca Bettencourt, Minseo Lee, Ho-Seok Ee, et al.

We select the SIL Open Font License version 1.1 option for these fonts.
The eight generated binary font files, their font source, and independent
font-generation script are distributed under OFL-1.1; see OFL-1.1.txt.
The original release's dual-license statement is retained verbatim in
UPSTREAM-COPYING.txt; UPSTREAM-BDF-HEADER.txt retains its copyright metadata.
The upstream name describes provenance only, not this modified family or
an endorsement. Existing opaque asset filenames are compatibility keys,
not family names. These fonts must not be sold by themselves.

Changes: conversion from row-major HEX to fixed UTF-16-indexed column-major
MSB-first tables; deterministic area scaling to 8/12/14 pixels; rightward
one-pixel bold dilation that preserves single-pixel horizontal counters.
Eight-column glyphs retain horizontal detail; wide glyphs fit the square cell. 16px normal retains original source glyph geometry
inside a fixed 16x16 cell. No original application font data is incorporated.
All 65,536 BMP offsets remain available in each large table; 8px tables keep
128 slots. Missing upstream slots are blank. This is not a shaping engine:
no supplementary-plane support, surrogate pairing, bidi, or contextual
Arabic/Indic shaping is added. Existing application restrictions remain.
Scaling can merge fine strokes, particularly in dense CJK at 12/14 pixels
and 8px compatibility. Pixel equivalence to the old app is not claimed.

Source: https://unifoundry.com/pub/unifont/unifont-16.0.04/unifont-16.0.04.tar.gz
Only font data and licensing/documentation extracted. No upstream program
source, executable, installer, or utility was executed or used in conversion.
Rebuild: python3 tools/generate-matrix-fonts.py
The generated manifest pins input/converter/output SHA-256 hashes.
